name: Ramp
description: Ramp is the finance automation platform uniquely designed to save businesses their most valuable resources—time and money.
longDescription: Ramp is a brand that is revolutionizing finance operations for businesses of all sizes. By reimagining technology for back-office finance, Ramp provides essential tools to modernize finance operations and help businesses thrive. Their all-in-one solution combines corporate cards with best-in-class finance operations software, enabling customers to save money and free up their finance teams to do their best work. Founded in 2019, Ramp powers America's fastest-growing corporate card and bill payment platform. With over $600 million in customer savings and 8.5 million+ hours saved, Ramp has already made a significant impact. Their platform has received hundreds of 5-star reviews, with users raving about its innovative functionalities. Ramp is more than just a brand; it's a team of over 400 professionals with experience from leading financial services and fintech companies. They prioritize customer success, ensuring customers have a voice in every decision. Speed is crucial for Ramp, as they believe a simple solution that ships quickly is better than a perfect one that never gets released. Join Ramp to experience a whole new level of finance management and build a healthier business.
